jobDescription:
Description: We are looking for a highly skilled Digital Marketing Executive with strong expertise in SEO, Social
Media Management, and Paid Advertising. The ideal candidate should be able to drive brand
visibility, traffic, and conversions through strategic planning, execution, and continuous optimization
of digital marketing initiatives

Responsibilities:
- SEO (Core Focus)
- Execute on-page, off-page, technical, and local SEO across multiple websites.
- Perform keyword research, content optimization, internal linking, schema markup, and Core Web Vitals improvements.
- Conduct technical SEO audits including crawlability, indexing, site structure, page speed, mobile-friendliness, and structured data.
- Manage link-building, outreach, digital PR, citations, reviews, and geo-targeted SEO activities.
- Optimize content for AIO, GEO, and LLM platforms to improve visibility across AI-powered search and virtual assistants.
- Structure content to capture featured snippets, AI answers, zero-click queries, and conversational search.
- Stay updated on algorithm changes and emerging AI-driven ranking signals.
- Social Media Marketing
- Manage and grow social media channels: Facebook, Instagram, Twitter (X), LinkedIn, and other platforms.
- Develop and execute content calendars, ensuring consistent posting and branding.
- Research and implement new content ideas to boost audience engagement and brand visibility.
- Analyze competitor social media strategies for continuous improvement.
- Optimize social content with SEO and PPC integration where applicable.
- Use timelines and scheduling tools to maintain steady content flow.
- Monitor engagement, demographics, reach, and overall campaign performance.
- Paid Advertising
- Plan, execute, and optimize campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram), and LinkedIn Ads.
- Monitor budgets, enhance performance, and work towards improving CTR, CPL, and ROI.
- Conduct A/B testing for ads, landing pages, creatives, and messaging.
- Ensure proper tracking setup using GA4, GSC, and other analytics tools

Requirements:
- Proven experience in SEO (on-page, off-page, technical, and local).
- Experience with AIO, GEO, and LLM optimization for AI-driven search.
- Hands-on experience with Google Ads, Meta Ads, and LinkedIn Ads.
- Strong understanding of organic social media marketing.
- Ability to research trends and create engaging digital content.
- Basic understanding of HTML, CSS, JavaScript is an advantage.
- Strong analytical and data-driven approach.
- Up-to-date with latest digital, social media, and SEO trends.
- Strong communication and reporting skills

title: Project Coordinator/Project Manager
requiredSkills: Relevant project management experience of around 4+ years in an IT Services Company is mandatory.
Solid technical background, with understanding or hands-on experience in software development and web technologies.
Excellent client-facing and internal communication skills.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills with a good team player spirit would be the perfect match for our team.
Solid organizational skills including attention to detail and multi-tasking skills.
jobDescription:
Description: Immediate joiners: We are seeking project coordinators/project managers who will be able to coordinate people and processes to ensure that our projects are delivered on time and produce the desired results.

Responsibilities:
- A project manager will be the go-to person for everything involving a project’s organization and timeline. Specific project manager responsibilities include developing detailed project plans, ensuring resource availability and allocation, and delivering every project on time within budget and scope. Project managers should have a background in business skills, management, budgeting, and analysis. He/ She should be an excellent communicator and comfortable managing multiple tasks. He/ She also needs to be a team player and have a problem-solving aptitude. The various responsibilities are as follows:
- Coordinate internal resources and third parties/vendors for the flawless execution of projects.
- Ensure that all projects are delivered on time, within scope and budget.
- Developing project scopes and objectives, involving all relevant stakeholders and ensuring technical feasibility.
- Ensure resource availability and allocation.
- Develop a detailed project plan to track progress.
- Use appropriate verification techniques to manage changes in project scope, schedule, and costs.
- Measure project performance using appropriate systems, tools, and techniques.
- Report and escalate to management as needed.
- Manage the relationship with the client and all stakeholders.
- Perform risk management to minimize project risks.
- Establish and maintain relationships with third parties/vendors.
- Create and maintain comprehensive project documentation.

Requirements:
- Relevant project management experience of around 4+ years in an IT Services Company is mandatory.
- Solid technical background, with understanding or hands-on experience in software development and web technologies.
- Excellent client-facing and internal communication skills.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills with a good team player spirit would be the perfect match for our team.
- Solid organizational skills including attention to detail and multi-tasking skills.
